system.description:
The Kiasyd's fractured sight pierces the glamour of the fae; where others see a charming stranger, she sees the true creature wearing a ghostly human silhouette. Faerie beings can never hide their nature from her, and the passage of the fae leaves marks upon the world that only she can read.

The first effect is always in force and needs no challenge: you instantly recognize any fae being for what it is, seeing its true form beneath a mortal shell. To read an area for fae activity, concentrate for a turn and expend a Mental Trait; traces of faerie presence or magic worked there within the past three nights appear to you as faintly glowing footprints, runes or scorch marks. You always know whether such signs are present, though interpreting them may require one or more Static Mental Challenges (retest Awareness) at the Storyteller's discretion.
system.duration: Permanent / one turn for area check
